name: Discogs Releases Subset (22k Releases)
description: A large subset of the Discogs music database describing over 22,000 music releases. The dataset includes structured metadata for each release such as title, artists, labels, release year, genres, styles, formats, and country of release. The data was derived from the Discogs public database dumps and transformed into a research-friendly structured format. Discogs content is crowdsourced and curated by its user community.

variableMeasured.name: rec_uid
variableMeasured.description: Discogs-derived record identifier for the music release

variableMeasured.name: performer
variableMeasured.description: Artist or group credited for the release

variableMeasured.name: pub_dt
variableMeasured.description: Release date normalized to YYYY-MM-DD where available

variableMeasured.name: origin_loc
variableMeasured.description: Country where the release was published

variableMeasured.name: duration
variableMeasured.description: Total duration of the release in seconds

variableMeasured.name: imprint
variableMeasured.description: Record label that published the release

variableMeasured.name: category
variableMeasured.description: Primary genre or style of the release

variableMeasured.name: tracks_track-name
variableMeasured.description: List of track titles on the release
